about: Every source the F/A-18C build draws on (claude/plans/air-fa18c.md). use: trace = may be traced and matched; facts = its facts may be cited, its figures are never traced into the repository; look = looked at only. Photos (dvids*) are of the reference airframe, BuNo 164718, unless their aircraft says otherwise. fetch.py downloads each entry with a url into references/ and checks its hash.
